verdict.rationale: Fellow has a public pricing page that lists features such as AI meeting summary/transcription, Ask Fellow, keyword tracking, transcript redaction, audio/video uploads and bot avatar customization. The Super Admin API is tied to an Enterprise plan, so some tiering exists. Beyond that, the evidence shows no free plan, no dollar amounts, no mapping of features to specific tiers, and nothing on whether basic plans avoid a sales contact. missing for 10: evidence of a free tier, published per-tier prices, clear per-tier feature breakdown, confirmation of self-serve signup without talking to sales, independent corroboration.
